SlingSip · Phase 7E motion review

Native Electron screenshots of the 3D rig, four entries and real success/Later flows. The dashboard and bubble remain 2D. This sampled playback is a visual review artifact, not a frame-rate or CPU benchmark. Run npm run dev and open Animation lab for real-time motion and sound.

Entry bubbles appear after settling. Canonical water updates before the success reaction; the bottle retracts before the right exit. Later uses the existing left exit/retry policy. No real user data was used.
